entries.name: rr_sum_rows_f32
entries.signature: fn rr_sum_rows_f32(x:u64, dst:u64, ncols:i64, row:i64, tid:i32, bs:i32, shared:u64)
entries.grid: block_nums = (nrows,1,1), one block per row; row = blockIdx.x passed as scalar; tid = threadIdx.x; bs = blockDim.x in {32,128,512}
entries.preconditions: ncols >= 1 and ncols <= 2147483647 (native kernel takes int ncols); row in [0,nrows); x points at element 0 of the contiguous F32 source; dst holds one F32 per row; shared is a 32-element F32 shared buffer (required when bs>32, unused when bs=32); all addresses stay inside the checked span
entries.effect: dst[row] = native-order f32 sum of x[row*ncols .. row*ncols+ncols-1]; exactly one store per block, issued by tid==0 only

entries.name: rr_mean_rows_f32
entries.signature: fn rr_mean_rows_f32(x:u64, dst:u64, ncols:i64, row:i64, tid:i32, bs:i32, shared:u64)
entries.effect: dst[row] = sum / (f32)ncols with a single f32 division after the full reduction, issued by tid==0 only

entries.name: rr_sum_rows_f32_strided
entries.signature: fn rr_sum_rows_f32_strided(x:u64, dst:u64, ncols:i64, ne1:i64, ne2:i64, nb1:i64, nb2:i64, nb3:i64, row:i64, tid:i32, bs:i32, shared:u64)
entries.preconditions: rr_sum_rows_f32 preconditions plus: ne1 >= 1, ne2 >= 1; nb1, nb2, nb3 >= 0 (byte strides, zero allowed for broadcast); every row byte offset i1*nb1+i2*nb2+i3*nb3 divisible by 4 and inside the checked span (native reinterprets char* to float* under the same requirement)
entries.effect: row decomposed in i64 as i1=row%ne1, i2=(row/ne1)%ne2, i3=row/(ne1*ne2); row base = x + (i1*nb1+i2*nb2+i3*nb3)/4 elements; dst[row] = native-order sum of that row; tid==0 stores

entries.name: rr_mean_rows_f32_strided
entries.signature: fn rr_mean_rows_f32_strided(x:u64, dst:u64, ncols:i64, ne1:i64, ne2:i64, nb1:i64, nb2:i64, nb3:i64, row:i64, tid:i32, bs:i32, shared:u64)
entries.effect: same addressing as rr_sum_rows_f32_strided with the single f32 division by ncols on tid==0

internal_helpers: rr_block_sum(v:f32,shared:u64,tid:i32,bs:i32)->f32 : warp phase; when bs>32 lane0 of each warp stores shared_vals[warp_id], barrier, sentinel 0.0, lanes < bs/32 reload, second warp phase

rr_reduce_row(x:u64,ncols:i64,tid:i32,bs:i32,shared:u64)->f32 : fg169r_sync once before the first load; eight independent f32 accumulators in local f32[8] temp/sum_temp POD arrays (no heap, no slices, no VM allocations); guarded gather i<ncols else exact 0.0; per-accumulator adds in ascending j after each gather pass; final fold sum=0.0 then sum+=sum_temp[j] for j=0..7; then rr_block_sum

reduction_order_fidelity.per_thread: identical to native reduce_row_f32: eight independent accumulator slots; within each outer pass all eight loads happen first (each guarded, out-of-range contributes exactly 0.0) then the eight adds; final fold ascending j=0..7 starting from 0.0f; per-accumulator rounding sequences match the native two inner loops
reduction_order_fidelity.cross_thread: identical to block_reduce<block_reduce_method::SUM,float> in inputs/sdk-common.cuh: warp butterfly, optional shared phase over shared_vals[32] with __syncthreads and 0.0f sentinel, second warp phase
reduction_order_fidelity.mean: single f32 division sum/(f32)ncols on lane 0 after reduction, matching native dst[row] = norm ? sum/ncols : sum
reduction_order_fidelity.pdl: fg169r_sync is called unconditionally once per thread before the first load, matching ggml_cuda_pdl_sync() placement in reduce_row_f32; native reduce_rows never triggers programmatic launch completion, so no lc primitive is imported
reduction_order_fidelity.output: lane0-only: entries return immediately after rr_reduce_row unless tid==0; the single block_sum per invocation means shared is never reused while reads could still be in flight

policy.rr_row_block_size: fn rr_row_block_size(ncols:i64, nrows:i64, nsm:i64) -> i32 mirroring the native selection in sumrows.cu and mean.cu: if (nrows/nsm)<2 return 512; else if ncols<1024 return 32; else return 128; integer division on positive i64; preconditions nrows >= 1, nsm >= 1
policy.rr_row_shared_floats: returns 32 when bs>32 else 0; parent allocates 32 F32 = 128 bytes whenever bs>32 (native uses static shared_vals[32] and launches with zero dynamic shared bytes)
policy.grid: block_nums = nrows in every native launcher; PDL launch attributes (GGML_CUDA_PDL, kernel PTX gate) are parent decisions, the device side only calls fg169r_sync

precision: all accumulation, the cross-warp reduce and the mean division are f32 in Goose with the exact native association order; no native math intrinsics are imported, so this module cannot introduce FMA or rsqrt divergence; generated-C/CUDA FMA contraction findings remain a parent concern per inputs/CONTRACT.md
indexing: all loop indices, the row decomposition, element offsets and row*ncols products use i64 (u64 for raw pointer offsets) to avoid signed32 wrap; native parity keeps ncols within int32 because the native kernel signature takes int
unsupported: CUB device-wide mean branch of ggml_cuda_op_mean (mean.cu, compiled when GGML_CUDA_USE_CUB, i.e. CUDA >= 11.7 by default): when nrows==1 and ncols>65536 (or ncols>32768 under the CUDA-graph-enabled threshold variant) native uses cub::DeviceReduce::Sum twice with a pool temp plus a divide_by_count kernel. Explicitly deferred by task; NOT migrated, NOT emulated, and must not be claimed as migrated. Parent must route that shape to the native fg169r oracle path or reject it before launch.
Non-F32 element types (F16/BF16/quantized) are out of scope for this module.
Native launcher concerns (kernel selection, PDL attributes, stream handling, device/nsm queries) stay in parent C++; policy.goose receives nsm as a scalar.
